clips.title: The story
paras: Greatwood Vale is a forested valley nestled in the eastern foothills of the Stonetalon Mountains, reached via the perilous Webwinder Path. Recently, the hostile Grimtotem tribe seized the vale, using it as a staging ground for bloody assaults on neighboring settlements.

Tucked away off the Webwinder Path, Greatwood Vale has become a violent frontier. The Grimtotem tribe, under the ruthless leadership of Grundig Darkcloud, has moved into the vale in force, cutting off safe passage and bringing terror to the surrounding foothills.

The Grimtotem did not merely occupy Greatwood Vale; they used it to orchestrate the butchery of nearby Camp Aparaje. Sweeping out of the woods, Darkcloud's raiders slaughtered nearly every tauren inhabiting the encampment. Makaba Flathoof, one of the few survivors who managed to flee the carnage, now directs vengeful Horde warriors straight into the heart of Greatwood Vale to cut down the renegade Grimtotem and put an end to Grundig Darkcloud.
